name: SAMBAL SALMON BAKAR
steps: Pat salmon dry with paper towel. Rub turmeric and salt evenly.
Spread sambal tumis on flesh side.
Air-fry at 200°C for 12 min or oven-bake 200°C for 14 min.
Rest 2 min. Squeeze limau kasturi over top.
Serve with 1 cup steamed ulam and ½ cup brown rice.
chefsNote: Grill, don't fry. Frozen Norwegian fillet is 30–40% cheaper than fresh and nutritionally equivalent.

name: LEMON BUTTER PAN-SEARED SALMON
steps: Pat salmon completely dry — this is critical for crispy skin.
Heat pan on medium-high. Place salmon skin-side down. Do not move for 5 min.
Flip carefully. Cook 3 min on flesh side.
Remove from heat. Add butter, garlic, lemon juice to pan. Swirl 30 seconds.
Pour over salmon. Season with black pepper.
chefsNote: Crispy skin trick: the drier the surface, the better the Maillard reaction. Use a heavy-bottomed pan.

name: SETIAWANGSA SUNSHINE BOWL
steps: Arrange greens, cucumber, and tomatoes as base in a bowl.
Flake salmon over the top. Add avocado slices.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and salt. Drizzle over bowl.
Optional: add chilli flakes or black pepper.
chefsNote: Batch-prepare 2 bowls at night → lunch for tomorrow ready. Store dressing separately until serving.

name: SALMON NASI GORENG RINGAN
steps: Heat oil in wok on high heat. Fry garlic and chilli 30 seconds.
Add salmon. Break into flakes. Cook 1 min.
Add cold rice. Stir-fry 3 min, breaking clumps.
Push rice to side. Crack egg into empty space. Scramble quickly.
Add vegetables, kicap, and pepper. Toss 2 min. Serve immediately.
chefsNote: Cold rice = lower glycemic index + less sticky. Day-old rice is ideal for fried rice texture. Use only 1 tsp oil.

name: STEAMED GINGER-SOY SALMON
steps: Place salmon on heatproof plate. Scatter ginger and spring onion on top.
Steam over boiling water for 8 minutes (covered).
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil, and water.
Pour sauce over steamed salmon. Garnish with extra spring onion.
chefsNote: Zero added oil cooking method. The lightest dinner option in this collection. Pair with large portion of steamed vegetables.

name: SALMON AVOCADO TOAST
steps: Toast bread until golden and crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and pepper. Spread on toast.
Top with flaked canned salmon.
Add chilli flakes if desired. Serve immediately.
chefsNote: The 'emergency breakfast' — keep a tin of salmon and avocado in stock. Under 5 minutes from fridge to plate.

name: SALMON HEAD SUP — BUDGET OPTION
steps: Clean salmon head thoroughly. Remove gills.
Boil water with ginger and garlic.
Add salmon head. Simmer 25 min. Skim foam from surface.
Add tomato and bok choy. Cook 5 min.
Season with soy and pepper. Garnish with spring onion.
chefsNote: Cheapest salmon cut at the wet market. Rich in collagen from the head. The broth itself is nutrient-dense and filling.
